why_this_rate: Two of the cheap poles cascaded, which doubles both the skirt and the depth the stopband levels off at.
why_the_bypass_is_in_it: The byte carries a state the page prints beside its range, and the run took its flat reference at that state -- so a model that did not hold it could not render the reference every profile here is read against. It renders as no section rather than as a corner pushed out of the way, because the two are not the same: a pole parked at the top of the table still carries its zero at half the rate, and the reference would then hold a cut nobody measured.

map.why: One corner per setting the run asked, fitted from that setting's own skirt and belonging to this candidate alone. A readout and not a law: where these corners are is another class's and is already closed, and handing every candidate the same table would make the losers lose on the corner rather than on the shape.
